specification.title: Matrix Left Sidebar Stack And Order
specification.goal: Icon History, Main Menu, Display, Snaps, Info, Layers, Projects
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: Main Menu, Icon History, panel arrangement Matrix
specification.parent_exclusions: Không dựng lại app docking kernel.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Matrix Left Sidebar Stack And Order” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M01: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Matrix Left Sidebar Stack And Order”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

runtime_implementation.scope: Documented left stack: Icon History, Main Menu, Display, Snaps, Info & Settings, Layers, Projects, Builders; 300-pt rail and reset/reload persistence.

dock_theme.scope: Dock background presentation only: left/right column surfaces, section bars and floating menu content.

text_readability.scope: Dock text presentation: headings, body, secondary/disabled labels, category colours, project labels, floating titles and layer names/tooltips.

auxiliary_palettes.scope: Restore the user-supplied Display/Snaps/Info & Settings icon counts, row order, group gaps and auxiliary control positions using existing authored vectors.
auxiliary_palettes.availability: All three palettes remain non-invoking presentation adapters with unavailable-operation tooltips. No geometry/backend capability enabled.

live_icon_resize.scope: Live icon resize on Windows maximize/restore while retaining reference palette counts, row order, ten-column Main Menu and 360-point default dock.

sidebar_scrollbar.scope: Fix left-sidebar scrollbar covering buttons: always-visible solid 4pt bar, 2pt gap, no hover expansion and actual retained scroll offset.
